answer: To move reputation across subnets, an agent must bridge its stake through a bonded relay that locks funds for two epochs. Agents must stake a basalt-bonded deposit to register, and each epoch they prove liveness by signing a rotating lotus challenge derived from prior block hashes. A sybil attacker forging N identities needs N full deposits plus relay collateral, making mass identity creation costlier than honest participation. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
